methods.main: Unchanged 240101-parameter relational token-transport model and V1 checks. The sole corrective replaces torch.flatnonzero(x) with torch.nonzero(x, as_tuple=False).flatten().

acceptance.population: Exactly 188126 C01-C08 observations and unchanged 142184/45942 split.
